rules: A growth rate recomputed from the level it belongs to must match the published rate
warn past rounding; hold beyond 3× the tolerance and 0.5 points
Two different series carrying identical values (a reading list: sometimes a copy error, sometimes method)
An unusually large change (a reading list, not a hold)
The parts must add up to the published total
warn on the total; hold the one value common to two failing checks
An annual total sitting in a quarterly or monthly slot
hold (figures with four significant digits or more)
A year must equal the sum of its quarters or months; a quarter the sum of its months
warn; hold a series wrong in 80% of 5+ periods, or the value common to two failing checks
The same figure printed in two GSS tables must agree
A '% of GDP' figure must match the value divided by GSS's own GDP

The mid-rate is not halfway between the buying and selling rates (beyond rounding)
Dated on a Saturday or Sunday
The month's average of BoG's daily mid-rates differs from GSS StatsBank's monthly interbank rate by more than StatsBank's rounding

breaks: GHSXOF, GHSGMD, GHSMRO, GHSNGN and GHSSLL: from July 2007 BoG quotes units of the foreign currency per cedi; before that the same codes carry old cedis per unit. Established from the table itself: only this reading keeps the implied US-dollar cross rates continuous across the switch. Not documented by BoG, so TARIN does not publish these five pairs before July 2007.

The cedi was redenominated on 1 July 2007: GH¢1 = ¢10,000. BoG's daily table carries old cedis (¢) up to 27 June 2007 and new cedis (GH¢) from 9 July 2007. TARIN divides the earlier values by 10,000 for a continuous series.
Currency Redenomination Act, 2006 (Act 724); Bank of Ghana

GHSSLL changes from old leones (SLL) to new leones (SLE = 1,000 SLL) on 11 September 2026: 2,109.39 on 10 Sep, 2.1082 on 11 Sep, with the implied dollar rate unchanged. Sierra Leone redenominated on 1 July 2022. TARIN expresses the whole series per new leone.
Bank of Sierra Leone (1 SLE = 1,000 SLL, 1 July 2022); BoG's table
